verdict.rationale: System-wide AI dictation is a fair capability to ask of a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions speech-to-text or dictation, built-in or AI-driven. The cited items cover VMs, containers, search, dark mode, notifications and package management, none of which relate to this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate text anywhere in the system using built-in AI dictation
